This task reports; the Coordinator rules. `collision` and `recommendation` in particular are an executor's reading of what the tree contains, offered as input to a committed Coordinator decision. collision_basis: No record measures this contract's quantity (fake first fall degree d'_F under Definition 6 in the contract's declared equality form, with trivial Koszul falls excluded and measured) on this contract's object (the COSET-SHIFTED EQS4 degree-3 Weil descent of the third summation polynomial over F_{2^n}). That is `none` for the headline arm. But the contract's A-UNSHIFTED control arm is EQS2 in Nagao's own terminology, and two prior instruments have run a Boolean-ring Macaulay first-fall scan over EQS2-shaped chained-S_3 Weil descents at n inside the contract's 7-12 range, under a DIFFERENT fall criterion. Neither `none` nor `replication` describes that honestly, so: `partial`.
the_structural_finding: The program's shared Semaev/Weil-descent builder CANNOT CONSTRUCT A SHIFTED INSTANCE. src/semaev_tree.py contains no `coset`, `shift`, `v_i` or `offset` anywhere (query T-04, EMPTY RESULT), and make_V_subspace returns the F2-span of {1, alpha, ..., alpha^{k-1}} -- a subspace through the origin. Every descent this program has built from it is v = 0, which is EQS2 by Nagao Definition 4 (paper_fulltext.md:264-265, 'taking v1 = ... = vN = 0'). DC-3 is therefore untouched by prior work, and the novelty of A-SHIFTED rests on a checkable absence in code rather than on a failure to find something.

reuse_caveat_for_the_coordinator: The contract's `dependencies` block forbids importing EXP-ICPERF's converter because reuse 'would couple two audits through one implementation -- the exact defect the ICPERF review found when two engines behind one converter were mistaken for independent agreement'. It says nothing about EXP-ECTD's or EXP-SIG's files, which is why this is a ruling and not an executor's choice. One observation offered toward it: the same coupling argument applies with equal force to EXP-DREG-001, whose d_ff ladder is explicitly a reimplementation of ic_first_fall_fast's algorithm -- so the program already holds one instance of two nominally separate measurements sharing an algorithm.
recommendation_basis: The headline arm (A-SHIFTED / EQS4) is unmeasured and, on the evidence of T-04, was not merely unmeasured but UNBUILDABLE with the program's existing code. No existing measurement contradicts H-SEMBIN-a7e721, and the goal's own objective (2) already bars internal degree measurements from bearing on a Nagao assumption until the d_F / d'_F map is stated -- which is itself a completion criterion of this goal. A failed audit would have been the useful result and this audit did not fail.

questions.Q4: EQS4: NO -- no record asserts any first-fall value for a shifted instance, and no code can build one. EQS2: YES but weakly -- the EXP-DREG-001 d_ff ladder at n = 12, whose runs are failed_infrastructure or censored_timeout, which no evidence record carries, and whose quantity is differently defined. DEC-20260913-8d19e5's lineage: NO, it is a literature-reading decision asserting no measured degree. EXP-SEMBIN-db9bc3: NO, it takes d_F = 4 as an assumed input and tests cost sensitivity to d_F = 5.
questions.Q5: NO. Three independent blocks, any one sufficient: (1) wrong arm -- every existing measurement is unshifted, and a measurement on EQS2 cannot contradict a prediction about EQS4; (2) wrong quantity -- every candidate's fall criterion differs from the contract's equality form and none excludes trivial Koszul falls; (3) the goal record itself, objective (2), already states that internal degree measurements 'cannot be read as bearing on any Nagao or Semaev assumption in either direction' until the d_F / d'_F map is stated, and stating that map is a completion criterion of this goal. KN-OPEN-d218ec names the same gap from the Semaev side. See values_disclosed_deliberately for the one directionally relevant relation, which is about the CONTROL arm and is not a contradiction.
questions.Q6: NO prior MEASUREMENT of M-2. One prior PREDICTION of the trivial term exists: EXP-ALPF-012's meter_run subtracts trivial_koszul(degs, n_vars, D), an analytic count from the degree sequence, before declaring a fall -- structurally the contract's 'rank defect beyond the trivial one', but a predicted count, never reported as a degree, where M-2 is a measured degree. That script's own v1 post-mortem records the count going NEGATIVE (over-count) on a wrong degree profile, which is a recorded instance of the prediction disagreeing with the system and a concrete argument for measuring M-2 rather than predicting it. Screens Q-C03 (456 files) and Q-C04 (129 files) found no other instrument separating trivial from non-trivial falls.

recall_floor_note: THIS IS A RECALL FLOOR, NOT A CLEAN BILL OF NOVELTY. The kb retrieval index -- the instrument AGENTS.md and the contract's own proof_search_map name for this audit -- COULD NOT BE CALLED, verified by six independent probes (P-01..P-06 in searches.json): no crypto-kb MCP namespace is exposed to this session, kb/.venv and kb/.env do not exist, uv is not installed, nothing answers at the configured http://localhost:6333, and neither qdrant_client nor crypto_kb imports. 63 direct tree queries over 76,056 files were substituted. Three losses are structural and unrecoverable by more grepping: (1) SEMANTIC RECALL -- a record that measured this quantity while calling it a 'solving degree', a 'step degree', a 'rank defect' or a 'degree drop' is reachable by the index and reachable here only if the audit guessed the wording; the query set was widened for this reason and is still a guess-list; (2) CORPUS BEYOND THE TREE -- the index covers staged corpus material this checkout does not contain; (3) RANKING -- the index resolves exact identifiers first and orders by relevance, where a tree search returns a flat unranked list, which is why several screens return thousands of files and are labelled screens rather than findings. Per AGENTS.md, ABSENCE OF A RESULT IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT SOMETHING WAS NOT TRIED. Raising the floor costs: make -C kb qdrant-up; create kb/.env; install uv; crypto-kb stage-repo . && crypto-kb ingest; then re-run this audit. Named gaps within the tree search itself are listed in report.md 'What I could not determine', of which item 2 (sweeping the other 17 experiments that vendor semaev_tree.py) is the largest and cheapest to close.
